preconditions.description: The number of vertices n is between 1 and 10^5 inclusive.
The maximum path length l is between 1 and n inclusive.
The maximum path weight w is between 0 and 10^9 inclusive.
There are exactly n-1 edges provided in the input.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= p < i + 1 and 0 <= weight <= 10**4 for i, (p, weight) in enumerate(edges, start=1))
preconditions.description: Each edge i connects vertex (i+1) to a parent p where 1 <= p < i+1, and has a non-negative weight up to 10^4.

postconditions.description: The output is the string representation of the count of close pairs.

postconditions.expression: count_close_pairs == sum(1 for u, v in pairs if u < v and dist_edges(u, v) <= l and dist_weight(u, v) <= w)
postconditions.description: The count equals the number of pairs (u, v) with u < v such that the number of edges on the path between them is at most l and the sum of edge weights on that path is at most w.
